title: Nightmare in the Gallery
description: A man sits at a wooden desk with a glowing green lamp and steaming mug, writing or drawing while listening to a vintage radio. Behind him, a massive surreal painting or portal reveals a decaying hallway where two bloody zombies with axes advance toward the room, leaving bloody footprints on the floor as rain falls through a broken skylight.
